title: Studio: email template and translation editors in the All metadata area — a read-only base's template or bundle is customized as an override in <base>.custom
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P2, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P2 "N-25 email template and translation editors into Studio", and the last paragraph of its Consequences. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28410, #28407, #28562, #28561

Part of #28236 (P2, child **N-25**) · governs: ADR-0146 Consequences (last paragraph: "their simplified form editor is offered inside Studio's All-metadata area"), D1 (no Setup designer), D2 (the override lives in `.custom`) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: M.

**Business reason.** Today an admin who changes one line of HotCRM's welcome email, or one translated label, does it in Setup. That writes a package-less row which never exports, and which N-16b will refuse. With this card they edit it in Studio's All metadata area, and the change is an override in `hotcrm.custom`.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- Setup edits both types on the generic item page `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`, which does the overlay save and the `layered.resettable` Reset. It uses:
  - forms from `default-schemas.ts` (`translation` :118, `email_template` :302);
  - `previews/EmailTemplatePreview.tsx` (sandboxed HTML with variables) and `previews/TranslationPreview.tsx` (read-only coverage), registered at `previews/index.ts:60–61`.
- `email_template` is a bundle type keyed by `locale` (`default-schemas.ts:364`). `metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts#isServedOverrideRowOf` reads no bundle member. Whether N-10's read and N-09's gate key an override by `(name, locale)`: not verified.
- Studio has no host for either type. The Interfaces off-nav types are page, dashboard, report and view (`studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:2981`). The All metadata area is N-26a.
- Both types are `overridable` in `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts#OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION`.

**Wanted.**
1. In Studio's All metadata area (N-26a), an email template or a translation opens in a simplified form editor. That editor is the fields Setup's form offers today plus the existing preview, reused: one component, not a copy.
2. On a writable package, the editor writes that package's draft. On a read-only base, Customize takes N-17's path: ensure, a draft in the pair with `overrides: { package, basedOn }`, Publish on the pair, and Restore package original.
3. An email template is edited per locale, and its override is per `(name, locale)`. If the server serves or gates a per-locale override wrongly, the dev stops and reports a server gap, with no client workaround.
4. A translation's override is its whole locale bundle (whole replace, D2). The editor says so before the first save.
5. Setup's pages stay until N-28. This card removes nothing there.

**Tests.**
- Writable package: an edit writes that package's draft.
- Read-only base: Customize and an edit write a pair draft carrying the declaration, for one email template locale and one translation bundle.
- The other locale of the same template is untouched.
- Restore deletes the pair's item and the base reads back.
- A walled tenant admin sees Customize disabled.

**Release safety.** Safe on its own: it writes only through N-13 (#28407) and N-09 (#28410), and Setup keeps its form. N-16b (closing the package-less write) waits on this card, so admins always have a door for these two types.

**Not here.** The directory, lists and generic item page (N-26a). Directory marks (N-26b). Setup redirects (N-28). Removing Studio's overlay link (N-16b). View, dashboard and report (N-17).

**Dedupe.** #26649 and #27036 (closed: Setup opens each template locale as its own member). Searched `email template editor studio`, `translation editor studio`: no open card.

Links back: #28236, #28407, #28410, #26649, ADR-0146 D1, D2, Consequences.
